blocks.challenge: High volume of mixed inbound email inquiries — leads, technical questions, and noise — required manual reading, classification, and routing daily. Inconsistent handling and missed messages were a recurring problem.
blocks.built: AI classification of all inbound email into actionable categories. Automatic CRM logging. Draft response preparation for relevant inquiries. Human review and approval preserved on every outbound action.
blocks.result: Zero emails missed or misrouted. Staff time freed from manual sorting. Human decision retained on every reply. Operational consistency achieved from day one of go-live.

blocks.challenge: Incoming supplier invoices and client contracts arrived in varying formats — PDF, scanned paper, email attachments. Each required manual reading, data extraction, and re-entry into the accounting system. The process absorbed 6–8 hours per week and produced consistent data-entry errors.
blocks.built: Automated extraction of key data fields from incoming documents. Validation against supplier master records. Structured output prepared for accounting system import. Human review triggered only on exceptions and anomalies — not on every document.
blocks.result: Weekly processing time reduced from 6–8 hours to under one hour. Data entry errors near-eliminated. Staff attention redirected from data transfer to decisions. Consistent output from go-live day one.
